title: DreamShader
description: DreamShader turns text into Unreal materials. A .dss source is HLSL with declarations: uniforms become parameters and one export function becomes a material, or material functions. A .dsi builds a material instance, a .dsp a Custom Pass render pipeline (UE 5.8), a .dsh holds shared helpers; .dsm/.dsf are the older 1.x language. Sources live under the project's DShader/ folder and build assets at the same path under /Game. Use this tool to check, compile and preview sources, read their diagnostics, look up the UE.* and Substrate.* nodes a source can call, and turn an existing material back into text. Read the language reference before writing a source.

actions.name: check
actions.description: Parse and validate a source without building anything; writes nothing. The fast first test after every edit.

file.description: Source path relative to the project root, e.g. DShader/UI/M_Panel.dss

all.description: Check every source of the project instead of one file

actions.name: compile
actions.description: Build the assets a source declares. Writes assets: in the editor a ThinCustom material stays in memory, in the host it is saved. shaders=true also compiles its shaders and reports HLSL errors at source lines (always saves).

file.description: Source path relative to the project root

force.description: Rebuild even when the source has not changed

shaders.description: Also compile the shaders and report their errors

actions.name: diagnostics
actions.description: The errors and warnings this engine already holds from the last check or compile, without compiling anything. Without file: every file that has some.

file.description: Source path relative to the project root

actions.name: lookup
actions.description: Search the node catalog sources call: UE.* and Substrate.* nodes with their inputs, outputs and properties, and material attributes (m.BaseColor). An exact name gives the full entry; otherwise a list of names containing the text.

name.description: A node or attribute name, or part of one: UE.TextureSample, Lerp, BaseColor

actions.name: preview
actions.description: Compile a material source and render one PNG of it on a mesh. Builds the material as the editor does: a ThinCustom material stays in memory, a Graph material is saved.

file.description: A .dss, .dsi or .dsm path relative to the project root

mesh.description: Preview mesh; default sphere. UI materials always draw on a plane

yaw.description: Camera orbit yaw in degrees; default -157.5

pitch.description: Camera orbit pitch in degrees; default -11.25

force.description: Recompile even when the source has not changed

actions.name: info
actions.description: Plugin and engine versions, the source roots, the default backend, and what this engine process can do (editor or host, renders or not).

actions.name: decompile
actions.description: Write an existing material, material function or material instance out as a DreamShader source (.dss, .dsi or .dsp). Writes a source file, never an asset.

out.description: Destination relative to the project root; default under DShader/Decompiled/

readable.description: Prefer HLSL operators over exact node calls (a rebuild may then use other node classes)

overwrite.description: Replace the destination when it exists
